headline: Ivalue Infosolutions promoter Krishna Raj Sharma buys 35,661 shares
hook: Promoter stake increase at Ivalue Infosolutions
summary: Ivalue Infosolutions promoter Krishna Raj Sharma has acquired 35,661 shares of the company. Insider buying by promoters is generally viewed as a sign of confidence in the firm's growth prospects. Retail investors can track such insider transactions to gauge internal sentiment regarding the stock. The purchase reflects increased promoter holding in the company.
why_it_matters: Signals promoter confidence in the company's near-term outlook
